name: Call
tagline: Place and steer live phone calls through a SIP voice-model bridge
description: Aimed at developers wiring real telephony into an agent. A SIP bridge hands the audio to a live voice model, which follows the script, reacts to events mid-conversation and ends the call when the goal is met or the exchange is going nowhere. Add an approval step before it dials anything.
author: iserflott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
